title: Therapy Course Dates and the Visits a Course Holds
content:
## Rule

Under the Medicaid Managed Care Membership, which visits belong to a rehabilitation therapy course follows the dates of the member's rehabilitation therapy authorization, as the Prior Authorization record shows its course start date and its authorization end date:

1. Where the course start date falls inside the therapy window and the authorization end date has already passed, the course holds the visits dated within one more than the whole months elapsed since the course start date, less those dated within the whole months elapsed since the end date.
2. Where the course start date falls inside the window and the end date has not passed, the course holds the visits dated within one more than the whole months elapsed since the course start date.
3. Otherwise the course holds every visit of the servicing provider in the window.

The visits are the servicing provider's paid outpatient hospital claims. The therapy window is the 12 months counted back from the review date.

## Reading the dates

- **Counting months back.** A visit is "dated within" a number of months when its service date lies fewer than that many whole months before the review date.
- **Whole months elapsed.** The whole months elapsed since a date are the complete calendar months from that date to the review date.
- **End date passed.** The authorization end date has passed when it lies before the review date.
- **Start inside the window.** The course start date falls inside the therapy window when one more than the whole months elapsed since it is fewer than the 12 window months. A start date 11 or more whole months before the review date does not, and the course then holds every visit of the servicing provider in the window.

| Course start inside the window | End date passed | Visits the course holds |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Within one more than the whole months since the start date, less those within the whole months since the end date |
| Yes | No | Within one more than the whole months since the start date |
| No | Either | Every visit of the servicing provider in the window |

## Worked dates (hypothetical)

Review date 15 September 2026; course start date 2 March 2026; authorization end date 20 July 2026.

- Whole months since the start date: 6 (2 March to 2 September). One more gives 7, so visits dated after 15 February 2026 are reached.
- The end date has passed. Whole months since it: 1 (20 July to 20 August). Visits dated after 15 August 2026 are taken out.
- The course holds the servicing provider's visits dated 16 February 2026 through 15 August 2026.

Had the authorization end date been 30 September 2026, the end date would not have passed and the course would hold every visit dated from 16 February 2026 to the review date.
